mirrorTableAttestation.table: self-mirror AHIMOoTUVvWwXxY; cross pairs b<->d, p<->q; all other letters have no mirror image
mirrorTableAttestation.visual: Read from the 8x-upscaled image: the listed letters are left-right symmetric in that font; b/d and p/q are mutual reflections. i (left top serif), l (left flag), j, J, L, n, u (right tail), y, N, S, s, Z, z are not.
mirrorTableAttestation.officialPinning: Toggling the self-mirror status of any letter changes at least one available official/sample verdict except for efgjkwCDEFGJKLQRV; these remaining letters are visually unambiguous. 1309 of 1326 cross-pair toggles are not pinned by available tests; none is a visual mirror pair.
mirrorTableAttestation.ambiguityCaveat: Lowercase m looks nearly symmetric at this resolution, but official CF tests 18 (mm) and 20 (m) expect NIE, and 7 selected WA sources fail by treating m as symmetric. Ground truth is pinned; parent may want to note the visual subtlety.
mirrorTableAttestation.acceptedAgreement: All 12 selected CF-OK sources (each passed 168 official tests) implement exactly this table.

constraints: Exactly one line of 1..1000 ASCII letters [A-Za-z], optionally terminated by LF or CRLF (3 samples have no terminator). No spaces, digits, other characters or extra lines.
semantics: One line holding s, 1<=|s|<=1000 English letters. TAK iff for every i the pair (s[i], s[n-1-i]) is a vertical-axis mirror pair in the statement image (espresso.codeforces.com/baf8111c...png): self-mirror AHIMOoTUVvWwXxY, cross pairs b<->d and p<->q; everything else NIE. Image-derived table agrees with all 12 selected CF-OK sources and all 160 available official/sample pairs, which pin every visually ambiguous letter (m, n, u, i, l, s, S, Z, N, y ...). Unique literal TAK/NIE output. Oracle checks pairs with a mirror dict; the brute compares against a position-indexed mirror alphabet transcribed independently and against exhaustive generation of all s-palindromes from their first halves.

officialReview.missingTests: 11 of 168 are absent (truncated >400 chars per dataset card). All 8 modelled WA mutants first fail exactly at CF test passedTestCount+1 when rows 1..12 are CF tests 1..12 and rows 13..157 are CF tests 24..168, so the missing tests are inferred to be CF tests 13..23 (long strings). Available official tests never exceed length 16, so long inputs are covered only by authored maxSize cases.
officialReview.generatedTests: Row reports generated_tests=9; those open-r1 generated files are not in the input attachment and were not reviewed by this author. Parent must run parse() over them before use.
officialReview.note: All 157 official pairs and 3 samples parse within constraints and match the oracle token-wise; original bytes unchanged.

authoredTests.maxDimension: length 1000 (TAK and NIE, random s-palindromes, single-defect at positions 0/1/499/500/998/999) and 999 odd with centre defect
authoredTests.verification: Every authored output equals the independent position-table brute; unit tests also check mutants of 8 selected WA sources are killed by >=3 authored cases each.

bruteDescription: Exhaustive all strings over 52 letters of length 1..3 and over AbdmnpquwiS of length 4..5: recipe answer == independently transcribed position-indexed table (from CF-OK 19077833 layout) == membership in generatively enumerated s-palindromes (first half + centre + mirrored half); plus 3000 fixed-seed random strings up to length 60.
